recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is and do not re-add ServiceRequest.additionalRecipient unless a new WG decision reverses FHIR-49694.
issue_request: FHIR-46425 was an Applied/Persuasive OO R6 request to add ServiceRequest.additionalRecipient and requester guidance for additional recipients of ServiceRequest results.
initial_application: Commit 4a989ec22d019ba21c4b07cffa34088127162f46 added ServiceRequest.additionalRecipient and comment text pointing requesters to the new element.
additional_context: FHIR-49694 later reached Applied/Persuasive with Modification and explicitly reverted the FHIR-46425 change. Zulip and OO minutes show concern that a bare additional-recipient list was too underspecified and that CommunicationRequest was the better home for copy-results workflow guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made because current build-scope ServiceRequest source omits ServiceRequest.additionalRecipient and points copy-results workflow to CommunicationRequest, matching the later superseding decision.
